requirementSummary: The ticket defines UI behavior and data handling for Air Cooled (AC) and Evaporative Cooled (EC) condensers. Selecting a Condenser Type must display the appropriate input fields. AC inputs include Design Ambient (default 95°F, echoed in output 3.7), ASHRAE Summer Design, selection checkboxes, and dropdowns with defaults for tube material, fin material, tube size, and fin type. EC inputs include a system‑generated Bank ID#, copies count, EC Model dropdown from a catalog, and Wet Bulb Temperature. The system must record entered parameters, output condenser and circuit‑level configuration ready for ECS calculation, provide specific options for Condenser Passes (AutoOdd, AutoEven, 2‑41) and Roof Type (dark/light with/without parapet/shrouding).
businessRules: When the user selects the Condenser Type "AC" or "EC", the system shall display the corresponding input fields for the selected type.
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the Design Ambient field shall default to 95°F and its value shall be echoed in output 3.7.
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the ASHRAE Summer Design field shall accept a user-provided numeric value.
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the Default Condenser checkbox shall be available for user selection.
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the High Amb. / Altit. Cond. checkbox shall be available for user selection.
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the Condenser Tube Material dropdown shall default to "Copper".
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the Condenser Fin Material dropdown shall default to "Aluminum".
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the Condenser Tube Size dropdown shall default to "3/8, 3/8 w/ 1" spacing".
For Air Cooled (AC) condensers, the Condenser Fin Type dropdown shall default to "Corrugated".
For Evaporative Cooled (EC) condensers, the system shall provide a Bank ID#.
For Evaporative Cooled (EC) condensers, the Copies of this Bank field shall accept a user-provided numeric value.
For Evaporative Cooled (EC) condensers, the EC Model dropdown shall present options from the catalog.
For Evaporative Cooled (EC) condensers, the Wet Bulb Temperature field shall accept a user-provided numeric value.
When processed, the system shall output condenser and circuit-level configuration data ready for ECS calculation based on the provided AC/EC parameters and per-circuit cooling configurations.
When configuring an AC condenser, entry of ambient design conditions and coil geometry shall cause the system to record the AC condenser parameters.
When configuring an EC condenser, entry of the EC model and wet bulb temperature shall cause the system to record the EC condenser parameters.
When the user configures an AC condenser and selects Condenser Passes, the system shall display the options AutoOdd, AutoEven, and the integers 2 through 41 inclusive, in increments of 1.
When the user configures an AC condenser and selects Roof Type, the system shall display dark and light roof type options, each with variants with and without parapet/shrouding.
developerConsiderations: Implement conditional UI rendering to show AC-specific fields when Condenser Type = AC and EC-specific fields when Condenser Type = EC.

Provide default values for Design Ambient (95°F), Condenser Tube Material (Copper), Condenser Fin Material (Aluminum), Condenser Tube Size (3/8, 3/8 w/ 1" spacing), and Condenser Fin Type (Corrugated).
Support numeric input fields that accept both °F and °C units, with appropriate conversion handling.
Generate a unique Bank ID# on the system side for each EC condenser entry.
Populate the EC Model dropdown from the referenced catalog data source.
Render Condenser Passes dropdown with options: AutoOdd, AutoEven, and integers 2-41 inclusive.
Render Roof Type dropdown with dark and light options, each offering variants with and without parapet/shrouding.
Record entered AC and EC condenser parameters into the system’s data model for later ECS calculation.
Produce an output payload containing condenser and circuit-level configuration ready for ECS calculation.
Ensure that default values are echoed in the specified output fields (e.g., Design Ambient echoed in output 3.7).
